title: Maqaa Dhalootaan Dura Kenname
intro: Waggoota dheeraaf eegaa erga turtanii booda iddoo qulqulluu tasgabbaaʼaa taʼee fi kadhannaa cimaadhaan guutame tokko yaadi. Kan hin mul’anne irraa deebii maqaa kanaan dura kennamee hin beekne, ogummaa waggoota jalqabaa irraa abdachiisaa fi jireenya of kennuu, gara laafina fi qulqullummaadhaan mallatteeffame qabate dhufa.
clues: Ani osoon hin dhalatin Rabbiin ofii isaatiin moggaafame, maqaa naan dura nama kamiif iyyuu moggaafamee hin beekneen.
Warra maanguddoota sanyii dhalachuun waan hin danda’amne jedhanii yaadaniin akka deebii kadhannaa cimaatti naaf kenname.
Ogummaan, firdii fi Caaffata Qulqullaa'oon yeroon dargaggeessa turetti naaf kenname.
Warra kootiif dirqama kanan godhu siʼa taʼu, namoota kaaniifis gara laafessa kanan ture siʼa taʼu, of tuuluu ykn ajajamuu diduu hin turre.
Rabbiin nagaa narratti murteesse guyyaan dhaladhe, guyyaan du'ee, guyyaan lubbuun kaafamu.
Abbaan koo Zakariyyaan oduu gammachiisaa naaf ta’e ergamoota irraa kan argate qulqullaa’aa (mihrab) keessatti kadhannaa keessa osoo dhaabatee ture.

outcome.answer: Guyyaan dhaladhe, guyyaan du'ee, guyyaan lubbuun ka'u nagaan naaf haa ta'u

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
